title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：room　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 room 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the father ① gave the room that no neighbour in the house would have recorded, and he said the giving was the whole of the month. The ② room, meaning the space itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a room, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ room in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ room at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A room, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the father said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the room was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the space. The ⑥ room, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; room, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a space and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ room had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ room of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of recording; room, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ room I remember is the space recorded in the letter, which closed in 1994 and is still recorded as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ room, my mother said in 1996, is the only space that improves by being recorded; every room, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like a space. She said the freedom was the honest half.

room 意为“房间、余地”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这间余地就是那件事的全部。
room 意为“余地”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那间房间，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。

room 意为“房间之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的房间之事是一处老屋和三个月份的记载。
room 意为“房间；空间”，我记得的是家书里记载过的那一间，1994 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一间。
room 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，房间是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的房间。
